name: Greg Pace
tagline: Top rated Workers' Compensation attorney in Columbus, Ohio
about: Greg Pace is a top-rated attorney selected to Rising Stars for 2024 - 2027. He works at Malek & Malek Law Firm, located in Columbus, Ohio, and provides legal services for issues involving Workers' Compensation: Claimant to the surrounding community.
Greg Pace completed legal studies at Capital University Law School and graduated with the class of 2015. Greg Pace passed the bar in 2015.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
